evaluation: real local Ollama embeddings on disposable Testcontainers pgvector database
baseline: D-RAG-01C agent retrieval quality round 2 (scope-corrected), dev @ 2026-10-19
scopeDimensions: ALL_PROJECT_PRIMARY contains only questions without a user-named document; DOCUMENT_SCOPED_PRIMARY contains only explicitly scoped questions; SCOPED_ALL_PROJECT_REFERENCE is the paired all-project counterfactual and is excluded from both primary buckets
allProjectCounterfactualNote: 该 20 样本探索汇总包含六条用户已指定文档问题的全项目反事实搜索，不代表独立全项目问题集。
sourceCapStrategySemantics: A 使用生产 CrossDocumentSourceSelector，且装配预算通过 buildDiverse parity test；B 是测试侧相关度保护候选选择模拟；C 是测试侧保守折中候选选择模拟（保留 E6 覆盖保证同时消除弱代表占位）。B 和 C 的结果属于近似实验指标，不代表生产上下文提升。
